facts.fact: Cloud Exchange West Africa launched its Huawei-built prefabricated data centre in Lagos, offering Tier IV colocation, interconnects and cloud services to customers; the article is dated 2021-10-04 and gives no separate launch date.
facts.system: Cloud Exchange Tier IV data centre, Lagos

facts.fact: Cloud Exchange's CEO and its head of data centre operations say the launched Lagos data centre is Uptime Institute Tier IV certified (operator statement; the article names no certification stage); article dated 2021-10-04.
facts.system: Cloud Exchange Tier IV data centre, Lagos
